subject.title: fix(openrouter): add model-aware tool schema normalization for proxied providers

question: Should OpenRouter intentionally select the DeepSeek and Gemini tool-schema compatibility families by normalized downstream model prefix, including treating Moonshot/Kimi as the DeepSeek family?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proven for Kimi, but choosing compatibility behavior for every existing proxied model family is an owner-level provider contract decision.

options.title: Approve the mapped compatibility families
options.body: Accept the existing shared-family routing for DeepSeek, Google, and Moonshot/Kimi so OpenRouter sends schemas those downstream providers can accept.

options.title: Narrow the initial mapping
options.body: Limit normalization to the confirmed Moonshot/Kimi path until separate real-provider evidence supports the DeepSeek and Google mappings.

recommendation.title: Approve the mapped compatibility families
recommendation.body: Accept the existing shared-family routing for DeepSeek, Google, and Moonshot/Kimi so OpenRouter sends schemas those downstream providers can accept.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the implementation and its evidence, while the available context does not establish a stronger current-main area owner.
